response.original_title: {FAQ™Room Addition} How Can I Add a Room to My Virgin Voyages Booking?
response.overview: You can add a room to an existing Virgin Voyages Cruises booking by calling Virgin Voyages Cruise Customer Service at +1-866-254-7549 or contacting your travel agent. To add rooms to a Virgin Voyages Cruise, you must call Virgin Voyages Cruise directly at ☎️ +1-866-254-7549(US/Canada) or +44-120-420-8151(UK) or contact your travel agent, as this cannot be done online. Additions depend on stateroom capacity, ship lifeboat capacity, and current availability ☎️ +1-866-254-7549(US/Canada) or +44-120-420-8151(UK). The booking will likely be re-priced at current rates. To add someone to an existing Virgin Voyages Cruise room, you must call Virgin Voyages Cruise directly at ☎️ +1-866-254-7549(US/Canada) or +44-120-420-8151(UK), or contact your travel agent, as this cannot be done via the website or app.
